# Linketto

> Linketto is the multilingual "link in bio" page: all your links, products
> and contacts on one page that automatically speaks every visitor's language —
> 24 EU languages (Bulgarian, English, Italian, Spanish, German, French,
> Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Romanian, Greek, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Czech,
> Slovak, Slovenian, Croatian, Hungarian, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Irish,
> Maltese) plus 3 Italian dialects (Neapolitan, Sicilian, Lombard). EU-hosted,
> GDPR by default, cookie-free analytics, sales commissions 8/4/0/0% by plan
> (vs 12%/9% at Linktree). A product of Carbon Stealth VCC (Bulgaria, EU) —
> https://carbonstealth.eu.

## Facts

- Languages: profile pages render in 24 EU languages + 3 Italian dialects, chosen automatically per visitor; Linktree profiles are English-only.
- Plans: Free €0 (8% commission), Pro €4/mo (4%), Business €9/mo (0%), Founder €49 one-time (0% forever). Linktree charges 12% (Free) / 9% (paid).
- Sellers additionally pay a 1.9% + €0.30 payment processing fee per sale.
- Analytics without cookies: no IP addresses, no user agents, no personal data.
- Public profiles: https://linketto.carbonstealth.eu/u/<name>, automatic visitor-language selection.
- Digital product shop via Stripe Connect; delivery only after confirmed payment.
- Moderation is transparent: notice, human response, right of appeal — visitors never see a public "BANNED" banner.
- Hosting and data processing in the EU; GDPR applies by default.
